purpose: Offline benchmark of historically important regressions for coding-agent changes.

cases.symptom: Fresher WebSocket quote is replaced or ignored in favor of stale/lower-quality data.
cases.invariant: Fresh canonical quote/depth remains authoritative downstream.

cases.symptom: LTP-only or insufficient-depth quote reaches live entry.
cases.invariant: Live entry requires executable bid/ask/depth evidence.

cases.symptom: Requested quantity is treated as broker-filled quantity after partial fill.
cases.invariant: Broker fill/pending quantities remain execution truth.

cases.symptom: Ambiguous duplicate broker-position rows are accepted as authoritative.
cases.invariant: Malformed or ambiguous broker position snapshots fail closed.
Live-capable strategy code cannot create an independent execution path.

cases.symptom: Historical/backtest path diverges from the live-equivalent component pipeline.
cases.invariant: Replay parity reports drift instead of silently accepting it.

cases.symptom: Position sizing breaches per-trade or remaining daily loss budget.
cases.invariant: No lot is admitted when stop-risk exceeds the canonical budget.

cases.symptom: Order plan identity or lifecycle provenance drifts before broker submission.
cases.invariant: Executable plan identity remains canonical through entry gating.
